blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Efforts to improve access to water and address plastic pollution in rivers and oceans took center stage at a forum marking the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the Philippines and the Netherlands in Cebu City on Monday, November 23. The forum brought together representatives from government, business and other sectors to discuss water-related challenges and potential solutions, highlighting cooperation between the two countries in strengthening local water utilities, expanding household access to water, and reducing plastic pollution.
